response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM region_counts) AS share FROM region_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.region, s.cnt, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(above.cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(above.share) AS avg_share, AVG(above.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_above_by FROM above, avg_share a;
